selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What central belief is declared in the passage?
questions.answer: That only Allah is God.

questions.question: Whose united agreement is given as evidence in the passage?
questions.answer: The united agreement of all the prophets.

questions.question: What supports the prophets’ shared witness in this passage?
questions.answer: Their clear and shining miracles.

questions.question: What two things do those miracles do according to the passage?
questions.answer: They confirm the prophets’ message, and they are themselves accepted as true signs.

questions.question: What does the passage say these prophets point to about Allah?
questions.answer: That Allah truly exists and that He is One.

questions.question: How would you summarize the whole passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: All the prophets, supported by powerful miracles, agree that Allah alone exists necessarily and has no partner.

questions.question: What is a good one-line summary for an 8th-grade student?
questions.answer: All the prophets agreed that Allah alone exists as the one true God, and their miracles support that truth.

questions.question: Which group of people is the focus of the passage?
questions.answer: All the prophets.

questions.question: What does their complete agreement show?
questions.answer: It shows the truth of Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What kind of miracles are connected to the prophets in the passage?
questions.answer: Bright, powerful miracles that make the truth clear.

questions.question: What does it mean that the prophets are unanimous?
questions.answer: It means they are all in agreement and not divided on this truth.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the main message that this agreement leads to?
questions.answer: That there is no god except Allah.

questions.question: What idea about Allah’s oneness is taught here?
questions.answer: That Allah is one without any partner.

questions.question: What statement about Allah comes at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The statement that no one deserves worship except Allah.

questions.question: What proof is mentioned right after that statement?
questions.answer: The shared agreement of all the prophets.

questions.question: What feature of the prophets’ signs is emphasized in the passage?
questions.answer: Their strength and brightness.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: That His existence is necessary and certain.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: That He is one and not many.

questions.question: How do the prophets and miracles work together in the passage’s message?
questions.answer: The prophets give the witness, and the miracles strengthen and confirm that witness.

questions.question: According to the passage, who gives testimony about Allah?
questions.answer: All the prophets give testimony about Allah.

questions.question: What is the content of their testimony?
questions.answer: That Allah exists, and that He is one.

questions.question: What makes their testimony powerful in the passage?
questions.answer: The miracles connected with them.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the truthfulness of the prophets?
questions.answer: That their miracles support their truthfulness.

questions.question: How does the passage connect miracles to belief?
questions.answer: It presents miracles as signs that help confirm the truth of the prophets’ call.
